verses.tl: Bismillaahir-Rahmaanir-Raheem
Iqtaraba lin-naasi hisaabuhum wa hum fee ghaflatin mu'ridoon
Maa ya'teehim min dhikrin min rabbihim muhdathin illas-tama'oohu wa hum yal-aboon
Laahiyatan quloobuhum wa asarrun-najwal-ladheena zalamoo hal haadhaa illaa basharun mithlukum afata'toonas-sihra wa antum tubsiroon
Qaala rabbee ya'lamul-qawla fis-samaa'i wal-ardi wa huwas-samee'ul-aleem
Bal qaaloo adghaathu ahlaamin bal iftaraahu bal huwa shaa'irun falya'tinaa bi-aayatin kamaa ursilal-awwaloon
Maa aamanat qablahum min qaryatin ahlaknaahaa afahum yu'minoon
Wa maa arsalnaa qablaka illaa rijaalan noohee ilayhim faas'aloo ahladh-dhikri in kuntum laa ta'lamoon
Wa maa ja'alnaahum jasadan laa ya'kuloonat-ta'aama wa maa kaanoo khaalideen
Thumma sadaqnaahumul-wa'da fa-anjaynaahum wa man nashaa'u wa ahlaknal-musrifeen
Laqad anzalnaa ilaykum kitaaban feehi dhikrukum afalaa ta'qiloon
Wa kam qasamnaa min qaryatin kaanat zaalimatan wa ansha'naa ba'dahaa qawman aakhareen
Falammaa ahassoo ba'sanaa idhaa hum minhaa yarkudoon
Laa tarkudoo warji'oo ilaa maa utriftum feehi wa masaakinikum la-allakum tus'aloon
Qaaloo yaa waylanaa innaa kunnaa zaalimeen
Famaa zaalat tilka da'waahum hattaa ja'alnaahum haseedan khaamideen
Wa maa khalaqnas-samaa'a wal-arda wa maa baynahumaa laa'ibeen
Law aradnaa an nattakhidha lahwan laattakhadhnaahu min ladunnaa in kunnaa fa-ileen
Bal naqdhifu bil-haqqi alal-baatili fayadmaghuhu fa-idhaa huwa zaahiqun wa lakumul-waylu mimmaa tasifoon
Wa lahu man fis-samaawaati wal-ardi wa man indahu laa yastakbiroona an ibaadatihi wa laa yastahsiroon
Yusabbihoonal-layla wan-nahaara laa yafturoon
Am ittakhadhoo aalihatan minal-ardi hum yunshiroon
Law kaana feehimaa aalihatun illaa Allaahu lafasadataa fasubhaana Allaahi rabbil-arshi ammaa yasifoon
Laa yus'alu ammaa yaf'alu wa hum yus'aloon
Am ittakhadhoo min doonihi aalihatan qul haatoo burhaanakum haadhaa dhikru man ma'iya wa dhikru man qablee bal aktharuhum laa ya'lamoonal-haqqa fahum mu'ridoon
Wa maa arsalnaa min qablika min rasool in'illaa noohee ilayhi annahu laa ilaaha illaa anaa fa'budoon
Wa qaalut-takhadhar-Rahmaanu waladan subhaanahu bal ibaadun mukramoon
Laa yasbiqoonahu bil-qawli wa hum bi-amrihi ya'maloon
Ya'lamu maa bayna aydeehim wa maa khalfahum wa laa yashfa'oona illaa limani irtadaa wa hum min khashyatihi mushfiqoon
Wa man yaqul minhum innee ilaahun min doonihi fadhaalika najzeehi jahannama kadhaalika najziz-zaalimeen
Awalam yaral-ladheena kafaroo annas-samaawaati wal-arda kaanataa ratqan fafataqnaahumaa wa ja'alnaa minal-maa'i kulla shay'in hayyin afalaa yu'minoon
Wa ja'alnaa fil-ardi rawaasiya an tameeda bihim wa ja'alnaa feehaa fijaajan subulan la-allahum yahtadoon
Wa ja'alnas-samaa'a saqfan mahfoozan wa hum an aayaatihaa mu'ridoon
Wa huwal-ladhee khalaqal-layla wan-nahaara wash-shamsa wal-qamara kullun fee falakin yasbahoon
Wa maa ja'alnaa libasharin min qablikal-khulda afa'een mitta fahumul-khaalidoon
Kullu nafsin dhaa'iqatul-mawti wa nablookum bish-sharri wal-khayri fitnatan wa ilaynaa turja'oon
Wa idhaa ra'aakal-ladheena kafaroo in yattakhidhoonaka illaa huzuwan ahadhal-ladhee yadhkuru aalihatakum wa hum bidhikrir-Rahmaani hum kaafiroon
Khuliqal-insaanu min ajalin sa'ureekum aayaatee falaa tasta'jiloon
Wa yaqooloona mataa haadhal-wa'du in kuntum saadiqeen
Law ya'lamul-ladheena kafaroo heena laa yakuffoona an wujoohihimun-naara wa laa an zuhoorihim wa laa hum yunsaroon
Bal ta'teehim baghtatan fatabhatuhum falaa yastatee'oona raddahaa wa laa hum yunzaroon
Wa laqadi ustuhzi'a birusulin min qablika fahaaqa billadheena sakhiroo minhum maa kaanoo bihi yastahzi'oon
Qul man yakla'uukum bil-layli wan-nahaari minar-Rahmaani bal hum an dhikri rabbihim mu'ridoon
Am lahum aalihatun tamna'uhum min dooninaa laa yastatee'oona nasra anfusihim wa laa hum minnaa yushaboon
Bal matta'naa haa'ulaa'i wa aabaa'ahum hattaa taala alayhimul-umuru afalaa yarawna annaa na'til-arda nanqusuhaa min atraafihaa afahumul-ghaaliboon
Qul innamaa undhirukum bil-wahyi wa laa yasma'us-summud-du'aa'a idhaa maa yundharoon
Wa la-in massathum nafhatun min adhaabi rabbika layaqoolunna yaa waylanaa innaa kunnaa zaalimeen
Wa nada'ul-mawaazeenal-qista liyawmil-qiyaamati falaa tuzlamu nafsun shay'an wa in kaana mithqaala habbatin min khardalin ataynaa bihaa wa kafaa binaa haasibeen
Wa laqad aataynaa moosaa wa haaroonal-furqaana wa diyaa'an wa dhikran lilmuttaqeen
Al-ladheena yakhshawna rabbahum bil-ghaybi wa hum minas-saa'ati mushfiqoon
Wa haadhaa dhikrun mubaarakun anzalnaahu afa'antum lahu munkiroon
Wa laqad aataynaa ibraaheema rushdahu min qablu wa kunnaa bihi aalimeen
Idh qaala li-abeehi wa qawmihi maa haadhihit-tamaatheelul-latee antum lahaa aakifoon
Qaaloo wajadnaa aabaa'anaa lahaa aabideen
Qaala laqad kuntum antum wa aabaa'uukum fee dalaalin mubeen
Qaaloo aji'tanaa bil-haqqi am anta minal-laa'ibeen
Qaala bal rabbukum rabbus-samaawaati wal-ardil-ladhee fatarahunna wa anaa alaa dhaalikum minash-shaahideen
Wa taalllahi la-akeedanna asnaamakum ba'da an tuwalloo mudbireen
Faja'alahum judhaadhan illaa kabeeran lahum la-allahum ilayhi yarji'oon
Qaaloo man fa-ala haadhaa bi-aalihatinaa innahu laminaz-zaalimeen
Qaaloo sami'naa fatan yadhkuruhum yuqaalu lahu ibraaheem
Qaaloo fa'too bihi alaa a'yunin-naasi la-allahum yashhadoon
Qaaloo a'anta fa-alta haadhaa bi-aalihatinaa yaa ibraaheem
Qaala bal fa-alahu kabeeruhum haadhaa faas'aloohum in kaanoo yantiqoon
Faraja'oo ilaa anfusihim faqaaloo innakum antumuz-zaalimoon
Thumma nukisoo alaa ru'oosihim laqad alimta maa haa'ulaa'i yantiqoon
Qaala afata'budoona min doonillaahi maa laa yanfa'ukum shay'an wa laa yadurrukum
Uffin lakum wa limaa ta'budoona min doonillaahi afalaa ta'qiloon
Qaaloo harriqoohu wansuroo aalihatakum in kuntum fa-ileen
Qulnaa yaa naaru koonee bardan wa salaaman alaa ibraaheem
Wa araadoo bihi kaydan faja'alnaahumul-akhsareen
Wa najjaynaahu wa lootan ilal-ardil-latee baaraknaa feehaa lil-aalameen
Wa wahabnaa lahu ishaaqa wa ya'qooba naafilatan wa kullan ja'alnaa saaliheen
Wa ja'alnaahum a'immatan yahdoona bi-amrinaa wa awhaynaa ilayhim fi'lal-khayraati wa iqaamas-salaati wa eetaa'az-zakaati wa kaanoo lanaa aabideen
Wa lootan aataynaahu hukman wa ilman wa najjaynaahu minal-qaryatil-latee kaanat ta'malul-khabaa'itha innahum kaanoo qawma saw'in faasiqeen
Wa adkhalnaahu fee rahmatinaa innahu minas-saaliheen
Wa noohan idh naadaa min qablu fastajabnaa lahu fanajjaynaahu wa ahlahu minal-karbil-azeem
Wa nasarnaahu minal-qawmil-ladheena kadhdhaboo bi-aayaatinaa innahum kaanoo qawma saw'in fa-aghraqnaahum ajma'een
Wa daawooda wa sulaymaana idh yahkumaani fil-harthi idh nafashat feehi ghanamul-qawmi wa kunnaa lihukmihim shaahideen
Fafahhamnaahaa sulaymaana wa kullan aataynaa hukman wa ilman wa sakhkharnaa ma'a daawoodal-jibaala yusabbihna wat-tayra wa kunnaa fa-ileen
Wa allamnaahu san'ata laboosin lakum lituhsinakum min ba'sikum fahal antum shaakiroon
Wa lisulaymaanar-reeha aasifatan tajree bi-amrihi ilal-ardil-latee baaraknaa feehaa wa kunnaa bikulli shay'in aalimeen
Wa minash-shayaateeni man yaghoosoona lahu wa ya'maloona amalan doona dhaalika wa kunnaa lahum haafizeen
Wa ayyooba idh naadaa rabbahu annee massanid-durru wa anta arhamur-raahimeen
Fastajabnaa lahu fakashafnaa maa bihi min durrin wa aataynaahu ahlahu wa mithlahum ma'ahum rahmatan min indinaa wa dhikraa lil-aabideen
Wa ismaa'eela wa idreesa wa dhal-kifli kullun minas-saabireen
Wa adkhalnaahum fee rahmatinaa innahum minas-saaliheen
Wa dhan-nooni idh dhahaba mughaadiban fazanna an lan naqdira alayhi fanaadaa fiz-zulumaati an laa ilaaha illaa anta subhaanaka innee kuntu minaz-zaalimeen
Fastajabnaa lahu wa najjaynaahu minal-ghammi wa kadhalika nunjil-mu'mineen
Wa zakariyyaa idh naadaa rabbahu rabbi laa tadharnee fardan wa anta khayrul-waaritheen
Fastajabnaa lahu wa wahabnaa lahu yahyaa wa aslahnaa lahu zawjahu innahum kaanoo yusaari'oona fil-khayraati wa yad'oonanaa raghaban wa rahaban wa kaanoo lanaa khaashi'een
Wa-atee ahsanat farjahaa fanafakhnaa feehaa min roohinaa wa ja'alnaahaa wabnahaa aayatan lil-aalameen
Inna haadhihi ummatukum ummatan waahidatan wa anaa rabbukum fa'budoon
Wa taqatta'oo amrahum baynahum kullun ilaynaa raaji'oon
Faman ya'mal minas-saalihaati wa huwa mu'minun falaa kufraana lisa'yihi wa innaa lahu kaatiboon
Wa haraamun alaa qaryatin ahlaknaahaa annahum laa yarji'oon
Hattaa idhaa futihat ya'jooju wa ma'jooju wa hum min kulli hadabin yansiloon
Waaqtarabal-wa'dul-haqqu fa-idhaa hiya shaakhisatun absaarul-ladheena kafaroo yaa waylanaa qad kunnaa fee ghaflatin min haadhaa bal kunnaa zaalimeen
Innakum wa maa ta'budoona min doonillaahi hasabu jahannama antum lahaa waridoon
Law kaana haa'ulaa'i aalihatan maa waradoohaa wa kullun feehaa khaalidoon
Lahum feehaa zafeerun wa hum feehaa laa yasma'oon
Innal-ladheena sabaqat lahum minnal-husnaa ulaa'ika anhaa mub'adoon
Laa yasma'oona haseesahaa wa hum fee mash-tahat anfusuhum khaalidoon
Laa yahzunuhumul-faza'ul-akbaru wa tatalaqqaahumul-malaa'ikatu haadhaa yawmukumul-ladhee kuntum too'adoon
Yawma natwis-samaa'a katayyis-sijilli lilkutubi kamaa bada'naa awwala khalqin nu'eeduhu wa'dan alaynaa innaa kunnaa fa-ileen
Wa laqad katabnaa fiz-zaboori min ba'didh-dhikri annal-arda yarithuhaa ibaadiyas-saalihoon
Inna fee haadhaa labalaaghan liqawmin aabideen
Wa maa arsalnaaka illaa rahmatan lil-aalameen
Qul innamaa yoohaa ilayya annamaa ilaahukum ilaahun waahidun fahal antum muslimoon
Fa-in tawallaw faqul aadhantukum alaa sawaa'in wa in adree aqareebun am ba'eedun maa too'adoon
Innahu ya'lamul-jahra minal-qawli wa ya'lamu maa taktumoon
Wa in adree la-allahu fitnatun lakum wa mataa'un ilaa heen
Qaala rabbi uhkum bil-haqqi wa rabbunar-Rahmaanul-musta'aanu alaa maa tasifoon
